description: TrackMaster 修复三个遗留问题

userStories.title: 修复绘制模式点击地图不能添加点
userStories.description: 用户在绘制模式下点击地图无法添加点
acceptanceCriteria: 绘制模式下点击地图应在地图上添加点
点击后地图显示预览圆/多边形
可以完成绘制并创建围栏
userStories.notes: Fixed: Added isDrawingMode and isEditingFence as LaunchedEffect dependencies to ensure listener captures current state. Also read state values directly in listener callback for additional safety.

userStories.title: 修复灵动岛围栏高亮功能
userStories.description: 点击灵动岛里的围栏名称，地图上对应围栏应高亮显示（黄色边框）
acceptanceCriteria: 点击灵动岛围栏列表中的围栏
地图上该围栏显示黄色边框高亮
userStories.notes: Fixed: Added onFenceClick callback to TopStatusIsland and onHighlightClick to FenceListDialog. Connected to app.setHighlightedFenceId() for toggling highlight state.

userStories.title: 修复统计时间累加问题
userStories.description: 应用重启或创建新围栏后，统计时间应保留之前的累加时间，而不是从零开始
acceptanceCriteria: 从数据库加载今日所有未关闭的stays记录
activeSessions应保留之前的计时状态
数据可视化页面显示正确的累积时长
userStories.notes: Fixed: Added accumulatedDuration and lastSaveTime to FenceActiveSession to track duration across app restarts. Updated saveAllActiveSessions() to persist accumulated duration to both stays table and daily_stays. Updated loadActiveSessionsFromDatabase() to restore accumulated duration and load today's daily records into dailyCache. Updated getCurrentDuration() to account for gap duration between app close and reopen.
